title: Plate Tectonics
description: The crust is broken into plates that ride on the hot mantle beneath. Where they part, rock wells up; where they meet, one dives under the other. Unlocks the Core Drill - the first tool that cuts bedrock - and the way into the Planetary Interior.

puzzle.goal: Rock of density ρ lies above you to a depth h, pulled down by gravity g. Write the pressure P it presses on you with.
puzzle.name: Lithostatic pressure
puzzle.ask: Find P in gigapascals 100 km down, with rock of density R = @{R} kg/m³ and g = @{g} m/s².
puzzle.method: Each layer carries the weight of everything above it: a column of area A and height h weighs ρ·A·h·g.
